key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Tagged record `Body = { active: BodyType; raw: RawBody; urlencoded: UrlencodedBody }`; `BodyType='none'\

Body lives only in `tab.spec.body`; BodyEditor reads via a `tabsStore` selector, writes an immutable full-`Body` patch via `updateActiveSpec({ body })` for raw-text/lang/rows/active edits (mode switch mutates only `active`, carrying both sub-records forward). 6 panels mount-all + `hidden`-toggle. **Re-select early-return** on both the radio (`next === body.active`) and the lang-pill (`next === body.raw.lang`). The store-controlled textarea's `value = body.raw.text` (per-keystroke write → AC-14 + single SSOT); the `<pre>` overlay + gutter render their TEXT from the LIVE `body.raw.text` (immediate — the `<pre>` is the sole visible text layer), and ONLY the `compose()` coloring pass is debounced (applied when its snapshot === the live text; plain `var(--text)` while pending), so the expensive tokenise runs on the trailing edge, never synchronously per keystroke (§7 c3b) — without the visible text lagging
key_design_decisions.why: The STORE (retained `raw`+`urlencoded` sub-records) preserves VALUES → AC-14; mount-all/`hidden` preserves only DOM-local scroll/caret + satisfies AC-6, NOT values. Store-controlled textarea reading `body.raw.text` keeps the `<pre>` overlay fresh (AC-9, coloring converges within one debounce interval) while surviving switches (AC-14) — dissolves F-001's both-horns objection with no local draft (§5.2). Re-select early-return needed because the store no-op guard is reference-based (tabsStore.ts:344); debouncing ONLY the coloring pass (not the text render) needed because a store-controlled textarea would otherwise re-tokenise the full body per keystroke (F3, §7 c3b), yet debouncing the whole snapshot would freeze the sole visible text layer (F3 cycle-3 regression)
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: "mount-all preserves per-mode value" (F-001: false — DOM-local only); local component draft state per mode (dual source of truth, §5.2); relying on the store no-op guard to absorb re-selects (F2: reference equality misses fresh-equal objects); render-time `compose(body.raw.text)` on the live store value (F3: bounded-but-still-synchronous full-body tokenise per sub-threshold keystroke, violates §7 c3b); debouncing the ENTIRE `<pre>` snapshot including its text (F3 cycle-3: freezes the sole visible text layer during a burst — typed chars invisible up to one interval)

{rows:readonly Row[]; onRowsChange:(r:Row[])=>void}) & { validVars?: ReadonlySet<string> }` — a **prop union** `{field}` vs `{rows,onRowsChange}` (runtime-narrowed via `'rows' in props`, not type-level XOR — see §3.1) **intersected with the retained shared optional `validVars?`** (F4, KVTable.tsx:26-34, gates the `.missing` highlight at renderSegments L74); add an `onRowsChange` **early-return in `writeRows`** before the `field==='params'` branch (`if ('rows' in props){props.onRowsChange(nextRows);return}`), and **guard the store-read selector** so `tab.spec[field]` is indexed only in field mode; BodyEditor injects the controlled KVTable via the `renderUrlencoded` render-prop at App root

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: `tabsStore` re-exports `Body`, `RawBody`, `UrlencodedBody`, `BodyType`, `RawLang`, `Row`; BodyEditor imports all body/Row types from `@renderer/lib/tabsStore`, never requestSpec. **`isRawBody` no longer exported** (removed in D1)
key_design_decisions.why: AC-13 + §5.2 (requestSpec component-invisible); pre-existing type-only `Row` import in KVTable left unchanged (out of scope; type-only erases at compile)
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: direct requestSpec import in BodyEditor: violates AC-13/§5.2; refactoring KVTable's Row import this feature: out of scope

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Radio = `role=radiogroup` container + `role=radio`/`aria-checked`/roving arrow-key focus over the design `div+.dot`; on select, write `body.active` only (early-return when `next === body.active`); lang-pill = button semantics + aria, writes `body.raw.lang` only when `next !== body.raw.lang` (early-return otherwise, mirrors the radio guard — F2); 6 panels mount-all + `hidden`-toggle; urlencoded panel renders the `renderUrlencoded` render-prop slot bound to `body.urlencoded.rows`; code area = real `<textarea>` bound to `body.raw.text` (editable, native caret/IME, per-keystroke store write) + aria-hidden `<pre>` whose TEXT renders from the LIVE `body.raw.text` every keystroke (immediate, plain, no tokenise) and whose COLORING is `compose(snapshot, lang, validVars)` applied only when `snapshot === body.raw.text` (typing paused); while `snapshot` is stale the `<pre>` shows live text as plain `var(--text)` segments (D6 plain-degrade). `snapshot` = trailing-debounced (`BODY_HIGHLIGHT_DEBOUNCE_MS`, default 100ms — applies ONLY to the coloring pass, F3 cycle-3). `.gutter` node count derives from the LIVE `body.raw.text` (⇒ gutter == pre rendered-line-count by construction, AC-23); no `contenteditable`/`innerHTML`; single scroll source = textarea, `<pre>`+gutter track `scrollTop/Left`; identical mono metrics + line-height 1.65 + padding + tab-size (three-layer alignment invariant)
key_design_decisions.why: Meets AC-5/6/8/18/23/24 + §7 constraints 1/2/3/5/6; reuses the proven mount-all/hidden pattern; textarea-not-contenteditable is the §7-mandated safe editable surface; store-controlled textarea + retained `body.raw` survives mode switches (AC-14); rendering the `<pre>` text + gutter from the LIVE `body.raw.text` keeps typed chars + line counts immediate (the `<pre>` is the sole visible text layer), while debouncing ONLY the `compose()` coloring keeps the expensive tokenise off the keystroke hot path (§7 c3b); colored spans swap in on the trailing edge with no layout shift (same text, same metrics, color-only) — AC-9 converges within one interval; gutter derived from the live text ⇒ counts match by construction (AC-23)
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: third-party editor: §6 OOS, breaks fidelity diff; contenteditable: caret/IME/XSS hazard (§7); uncontrolled/ref-driven textarea to decouple the overlay (F3 Option b: introduces a second source of truth — DOM value vs store — contradicting D2/§5.2 single-SSOT); debouncing the visible text render itself (F3 cycle-3: freezes the sole visible text layer); `useDeferredValue` (no stated interval, behavior varies with render pressure, harder to assert/tune)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: `jsonTokens.ts`: renderer-pure, JSON-only vocab, typed token segments; a pure `compose(text, lang, validVars)` overlays `tokenizeVars` on JSON tokens — `{{var}}` substrings lift to `.tk-var`, **var-pass-wins** inside strings; var pass applies to ALL raw langs, JSON structural pass only when `lang==='json'`; empty→zero tokens, malformed→single plain `var(--text)` segment, both no-throw; **perf ceiling has TWO parts satisfying §7 c3**: (a) above threshold (tunable, default 50 000 chars) skip the JSON pass → degrade to plain `var(--text)`; (b) below threshold, `compose()` runs **off-keystroke on a trailing debounce** (`BODY_HIGHLIGHT_DEBOUNCE_MS`, default 100ms — governs the COLORING pass ONLY, never the plain-text render), never synchronously per keystroke — BodyEditor calls `compose()` on the debounced snapshot and applies its spans only when the snapshot === the live text; while pending, the `<pre>` renders the live text via the same plain `var(--text)` degrade path as (a); `jsonTokens` itself stays a pure sync function
key_design_decisions.why: Meets AC-1/9/10/16/17/22 + §7 constraint 3 (both clauses a+b); imports nothing renderer-external (§2.2); XSS-safe escaped-JSX render (§7 constraint 5); XML/HTML/Text structural highlight stays OOS (§6) — render plain, var pass only
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: real XML/HTML tokenizer: §6 OOS, invents `.tk-tag/attr` classes fidelity cannot check; regex-`innerHTML` highlight: XSS + fidelity risk; render-time `compose(body.raw.text)` on the live store value (F3: bounded-but-still-synchronous full-body tokenise per sub-threshold keystroke, violates §7 c3b); unbounded synchronous tokenise per keystroke: perf-ceiling violation

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: `assertComputedStyle(selector,prop,expectedHex)` + `assertResolvesToToken(selector,prop,tokenVar)` over a live-renderer `getComputedStyle` channel; literal hex for tk-key/str/num/bool (AC-20/21), resolves-to-token for tk-null/punc/var (AC-22), grid + gutter/pre alignment (AC-23/24). **Anti-false-green gate = BOTH layers** (qa-engineer): (1) a setup-time channel probe that `test.skip('UNVERIFIED …')` marks the whole fidelity suite when `getComputedStyle` is empty/throws; (2) a per-assertion try/catch guard for mid-run channel loss. Critical: `getPropertyValue('--x')` returns `""` (not a throw) when undefined — the guard MUST intercept `""` as UNVERIFIED BEFORE any `expect`, else false-green (resolves-to-token) or unrelated hard-fail (computed-style)
key_design_decisions.why: Meets AC-2/19-24; asserts computed style not pixel-diff (reference renders SF on mac); fail-closed prevents the CT-passes-but-untested trap
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: pixel screenshot diff for token colors: font/reference drift → false results; silent skip when channel absent: false-green (violates AC-19); probe-only: mid-run disconnect still hard-errors; per-assertion-only: no clear suite-level UNVERIFIED signal
